queries.sql:
WITH map AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT old_id, group_no FROM jsonb_to_recordset(%s::jsonb)
    AS x(old_id bigint, group_no integer)
), matched AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT m.old_id,m.group_no FROM public.stable_articlehorselink AS c
  JOIN map AS m ON c.article_id=m.old_id LIMIT 50001
)
SELECT g.group_no,coalesce(s.referencing_rows,0) AS referencing_rows,
       coalesce(s.referenced_parent_count,0) AS referenced_parent_count,
       (SELECT count(*)>=50001 FROM matched) AS capped
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT group_no FROM map) AS g
LEFT JOIN (SELECT group_no,count(*) AS referencing_rows,
           count(DISTINCT old_id) AS referenced_parent_count
           FROM matched GROUP BY group_no) AS s USING (group_no)
ORDER BY g.group_no;
